newsitem.title: LIECHTENSTEIN: More than 30 escape Liechtenstein avalanche.
newsitem.headline: More than 30 escape Liechtenstein avalanche.

text.p: More than 30 people, mostly children and young people readying for a ski championship, escaped unharmed on Friday after an avalanche crashed down into the race area, police in Vaduz said.
The youngsters were in the starting area in a tent when the avalanche struck the Taeli area, in Malbun. The snow swept some of the children and their coaches up to 50 metres (yards), the police said.
All those involved were rescued alive. Police reported only minor injuries.
